summary: Chat now renders assistant replies as sanitized Markdown, including headings, lists, emphasis, quotes, tables, links, and code blocks. User messages, command approvals, and command output remain plain text.
instructions: Open Chat and ask for a heading, a bulleted list, and a fenced code example. Earlier assistant replies also render when the conversation loads. External HTTP(S) links open safely in a new tab; local links stay in Veyra. Scripts, embedded forms, unsafe links, and remote Markdown images are blocked. Code blocks and tables scroll horizontally on narrow screens. Draft protection and automatic version updates are unchanged. Formatting/security tests, JavaScript syntax checks, and all 157 Python tests passed.
